{{Quote|Captain Valek, we're approaching Communications Research Station Epsilon Nine.|Unidentified Imperial ensign on board the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Revenant (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Revenant'']]|<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire">{{GalaxyCite|3|Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire}}</ref>}}
'''Communications Research Stations''' were top-secret facilities in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the Empire was defeated during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|final battle]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], one such [[Space station/Legends|station]], [[Epsilon Nine]], attempted to defect to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] was dispatched to that location by Imperial [[Regent/Legends|stewardess]] [[Ysanne Isard]] to forcefully bring them back into Imperial jurisdiction.
